items.name: PrimitiveDictionaryBuilder
items.signature: struct PrimitiveDictionaryBuilder<K, V> where K: ArrowPrimitiveType, V: ArrowPrimitiveType

methods.name: append
methods.signature: fn append(&mut self, value: V::Native) -> Result<K::Native, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Append a primitive value to the array. Return an existing index if already present in the values array or a new index if the value is appended to the values array.

methods.name: append_n
methods.signature: fn append_n(&mut self, value: V::Native, count: usize) -> Result<K::Native, ArrowError>
methods.summary: Append a value multiple times to the array. This is the same as `append` but allows to append the same value multiple times without doing multiple lookups.

methods.name: append_null
methods.summary: Appends a null slot into the builder

methods.name: append_nulls
methods.summary: Append `n` null slots into the builder

methods.name: append_option
methods.summary: Append an `Option` value into the builder

methods.name: append_options
methods.signature: fn append_options(&mut self, value: Option<V::Native>, count: usize)
methods.summary: Append an `Option` value into the builder repeatedly `count` times. This is the same as `append_option` but allows to append the same value multiple times without doing multiple lookups.

methods.name: append_value
methods.summary: Infallibly append a value to this builder

methods.name: append_values
methods.signature: fn append_values(&mut self, value: V::Native, count: usize)
methods.summary: Infallibly append a value to this builder repeatedly `count` times. This is the same as `append_value` but allows to append the same value multiple times without doing multiple lookups.

methods.name: as_any
methods.summary: Returns the builder as an non-mutable `Any` reference.

methods.name: as_any_mut
methods.summary: Returns the builder as an mutable `Any` reference.

methods.name: extend
methods.signature: fn extend<T: IntoIterator<Item = Option<P::Native>>>(&mut self, iter: T)

methods.name: extend_dictionary
methods.signature: fn extend_dictionary(&mut self, dictionary: &TypedDictionaryArray<'_, K, PrimitiveArray<V>>) -> Result<(), ArrowError>
methods.summary: Extends builder with dictionary

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Builds the `DictionaryArray` and reset this builder.

methods.name: finish
methods.summary: Builds the array and reset this builder.

methods.name: finish_cloned
methods.summary: Builds the `DictionaryArray` without resetting the builder.

methods.name: finish_cloned
methods.summary: Builds the array without resetting the builder.

methods.name: finish_preserve_values
methods.summary: Builds the `DictionaryArray` without resetting the values builder or the internal de-duplication map.

methods.name: into_box_any
methods.summary: Returns the boxed builder as a box of `Any`.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of array slots in the builder

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Creates a new `PrimitiveDictionaryBuilder`.

methods.name: new_from_builders
methods.signature: unsafe fn new_from_builders(keys_builder: PrimitiveBuilder<K>, values_builder: PrimitiveBuilder<V>) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a new `PrimitiveDictionaryBuilder` from existing `PrimitiveBuilder`s of keys and values.

methods.name: new_from_empty_builders
methods.signature: fn new_from_empty_builders(keys_builder: PrimitiveBuilder<K>, values_builder: PrimitiveBuilder<V>) -> Self
methods.summary: Creates a new `PrimitiveDictionaryBuilder` from the provided keys and values builders.

methods.name: try_new_from_builder
methods.signature: fn try_new_from_builder<K2>(source: PrimitiveDictionaryBuilder<K2, V>) -> Result<Self, ArrowError> where K::Native: NumCast, K2: ArrowDictionaryKeyType, K2::Native: NumCast
methods.summary: Creates a new `PrimitiveDictionaryBuilder` from the existing builder with the same keys and values, but with a new data type for the keys.

methods.name: values_slice_mut
methods.summary: Returns the current dictionary values buffer as a mutable slice
